answer: Randomly sample witnesses instead of counting everyone. Each epoch, a public beacon draws a small random quorum of peers to audit any contested identity; only their signed verdicts count. A farmer with a thousand fakes expects most clones to sit out each draw, so swinging one vote means bribing strangers picked after the fact. Influence comes from being drawn, not enrolled: any single verdict is an ember of doubt that fresh quorums, redrawn each epoch from the knoll of established agents, burn away. Sybil mass stays parked in the inlet, unable to steer outcomes it cannot predict.
